CFML Language Reference: Functions

StructCopy

Returns a new structure with the same keys and values. Simple values and arrays are copied; structures and queries nested inside are shared between the original and the copy.

Category

Structure functions

Syntax

StructCopy(structure)

Parameters

structure
The structure to copy.

Returns

A new structure.

Usage

Remember that a plain assignment, <CFSET B = A>, does not copy a structure at all: A and B are two names for the same structure. Three levels of "copy" are available:

Code Top-level keys Nested structures
<CFSET B = A> shared shared
B = StructCopy(A) copied (arrays too) shared
B = Duplicate(A) copied copied

With StructCopy you can add, delete or change top-level keys of the copy without affecting the original, but changing B.Address.City also changes A.Address.City, because both point to the same nested structure. Nested queries are shared too; nested arrays are copied, as they are on every assignment. When the structure contains other structures, use Duplicate.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET Orig = StructNew()>
<CFSET Orig.Name = "Ann">
<CFSET Orig.Address = StructNew()>
<CFSET Orig.Address.City = "Boston">

<CFSET Alias = Orig>
<CFSET Shallow = StructCopy(Orig)>
<CFSET Deep = Duplicate(Orig)>

<CFSET Shallow.Name = "Bob">
<CFSET Shallow.Address.City = "Cambridge">
<CFSET Deep.Address.City = "Denver">

<CFOUTPUT>
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<TR><TH>&nbsp;</TH><TH>Name</TH><TH>Address.City</TH></TR>
<TR><TD>Orig</TD><TD>#Orig.Name#</TD><TD>#Orig.Address.City#</TD></TR>
<TR><TD>Alias (same structure)</TD><TD>#Alias.Name#</TD><TD>#Alias.Address.City#</TD></TR>
<TR><TD>Shallow (StructCopy)</TD><TD>#Shallow.Name#</TD><TD>#Shallow.Address.City#</TD></TR>
<TR><TD>Deep (Duplicate)</TD><TD>#Deep.Name#</TD><TD>#Deep.Address.City#</TD></TR>
</TABLE>
<P>Changing Shallow.Name left Orig.Name alone, but changing Shallow.Address.City
also changed Orig's city: the nested structure is shared. Deep is fully independent.</P>
</CFOUTPUT>

Duplicate, StructAppend, StructNew
